title: Near full groups of bounded type, II
summary: We study when a finitely generated group of bounded type contains the AF alternating group of the tail groupoid of its defining Bratteli diagram. This containment is an input to the full group completion theorem of Part I. We give sufficient conditions for this containment, in which selectors separate inherited diagonal actions, and an exact criterion for finite regular coverings. In the covering case, the intersection with the AF alternating group is the centralizer of the deck transformations commuting with the adjoined AF permutations.
